_comment: Module 6 (2026-05-09) — most crons paused per founder direction. The 36 prior schedules were removed. Two pre-intent crons re-enabled in Phase AA-3 (2026-05-09 late evening) because the parcel-synthesis + ZIP-aggregate-refresh path is dead without them; both run weekly + are bounded.

crons._comment: Phase AA-3 — refresh zip_pre_intent_aggregates so the 3 ZIP-aggregate reason codes (nearby_adu_activity_90d, nearby_remodel_activity_90d, neighborhood_upgrade_trend) stay current. Runs at Sunday 03:00 UTC, BEFORE the synthesis cron at 04:00 UTC.

Phase AA-3 — synthesise pre_intent leads from parcels_sidecar. Runs Sunday 04:00 UTC, weekly. Bounded by GLOBAL_INSERT_CAP_PER_RUN (2000 leads) + PER_CONTRACTOR_PER_ZIP_CAP (50). Uses the (state_code, situs_zip) compound index via the ZIP_PREFIX_TO_STATES filter.
